name: Stage paths config tarball in /tmp, verify, then move to ~/Documents

data.command: tar czf /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz -C /etc paths paths.d && tar tzf /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz | head -5 && mv /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz ~/Documents/paths-config-backup.tar.gz

submissions.reason: Archive non-authentication paths config (/etc/paths and /etc/paths.d) instead of /etc/pam.d — tarball → inspect → promote to Documents, still exercises tar without PAM/authentication-boundary reads.

cleanup.reason: Remove the paths config backup tar from ~/Documents and any leftover staging copy under /tmp.
